summary: Comprehensive testing of new features: Education page header, Auth redirect to /panel, User Panel Packages section, Profile Modal, and backend APIs (packages, user profile). Backend: 23/23 tests passed. Frontend: All major features functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Playwright force click on user-dropdown-btn does not reliably open the dropdown (Playwright click coordinates may be off due to fixed positioning with z-50 promo banner). Works correctly via JS click and visually confirmed in screenshot. Not a real user-facing bug, only affects automated testing.

issues: Hero stat 'Eğitim & Seminer' shows '2' (from DB) instead of 9 (from static fallback). This is expected behavior - DB has only 1 course and 1 seminar. Not a bug.

The '.rounded-full' CSS selector in sidebar matches the avatar circle div (initials 'TU') rather than the plan badge span. Visually both initials and plan badge are correctly displayed (confirmed in screenshots). Test selector issue only.

action_items: MINOR: UserPanelPage.js is 1429 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline significantly. Consider splitting into separate files: ProfileModal.js, PackagesSection.js, and section-specific components.
MINOR: Playwright automation for TopHeader dropdown button click may need specific coordinate-based click or waiting for dropdown open state. Workaround: use JS click. Not a user-facing bug.
critical_code_review_comments: UserPanelPage.js: 1429 lines - nearly double the 700-line limit. Should be split into smaller focused component files (ProfileModal, PackagesSection, SidebarSection, TopHeader, etc.).
GET /packages is a static hardcoded response (no DB backing). If packages need to be configurable by admin, they should be moved to DB. Currently fine for MVP.
PUT /api/user/profile: Empty full_name silently doesn't update name (correctly). This is correct behavior but worth noting in docs.
ProfileModal: withCredentials is passed in the API call which is correct for session-based auth.
Education page: `isLoggedIn` function checks both `app_user` and `admin_token` localStorage keys - this is correct for both user and admin to see the panel button.

success_rate.frontend: 93% - All critical flows pass. Minor: TopHeader dropdown Playwright click issue (not a real bug, works via JS/manual)
